concepts.name: 교차하는 검
concepts.motif: Ivory and emerald enamel ceremonial swords with gold blades and a small central four-point star.
concepts.progression: 50: one upright sword. 100: two crossed swords. 1,000: three swords in a balanced fan with a green ribbon. 10,000: five swords in a grand but readable fan with a fuller ribbon. Preserve the same shield rim and center star throughout.
concepts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept / product-mockup.
Create ONE landscape comparison sheet about 2.4:1 aspect ratio with EXACTLY FOUR fully visible physical collectible clan enamel pins in one evenly spaced horizontal row, left to right 50, 100, 1,000, 10,000 milestones. All four belong to one evolving design family.
Family: 교차하는 검. Outer contour: a broad classic shield. Motif: Ivory and emerald enamel ceremonial swords with gold blades and a small central four-point star.
Progression from left to right: 50: one upright sword. 100: two crossed swords. 1,000: three swords in a balanced fan with a green ribbon. 10,000: five swords in a grand but readable fan with a fuller ribbon. Preserve the same shield rim and center star throughout.
Materials for ALL stages: rich emerald, pale mint and warm ivory hard enamel, substantial polished WARM GOLD metal rim and seams, realistic jewelry relief, crisp beveled edges and carefully controlled dimensional highlights. Gold finish stays identical across every tier. The drawing grows in complexity; do not recolor the border for levels. Strong readable silhouettes at small UI sizes, a few bold forms, restrained detail.
Presentation: uniform matte charcoal #151918 backdrop, front-facing upright pins, identical lighting and same maximum pin height, generous clear spacing. Put only the exact plain ivory numeric captions "50", "100", "1,000", "10,000" outside and centered beneath their corresponding pins. No other text. No numbers or lettering on the actual pins. No case, hands, scenery, thick display frames, brand logos, game logos, watermarks, emoji, flat vector icons or fake glowing effects. Each actual badge must be a tangible premium physical gold-and-enamel object, not a pictogram. Every stage must match the specified progression and external contour.

concepts.name: 전장의 지도
concepts.motif: A sculpted ivory folded battlefield map with thick gold route lines and emerald waypoint stones.
concepts.progression: 50: one small folded map and one waypoint. 100: a wider map linking two waypoints. 1,000: four clear connected waypoints over a broader map. 10,000: a complete strategic map with a bold central hub and five surrounding connected markers. No tiny cartographic text.
